source_refs.note: Book p. 67-69: matrix inversion method, Example 12

blocks.text: Doosra tareeqa: matrix inversion method. Yeh tareeqa tab chalta hai jab coefficient matrix ka determinant zero na ho; phir solution hamesha ek hi hota hai. Is mein woh sab kuch istemal hota hai jo hum ne Section 4.5 mein seekha: minors, cofactors, adjoint aur inverse.
Matrix inversion method linear equations ka system matrix ke inverse ki madad se hal karne ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Poora idea teen lines mein. System ko \(AX = B\) likhein. Agar \(|A| \ne 0\) ho to dono taraf bayen se \(A^{-1}\) se multiply karein:
\[A^{-1}(AX) = A^{-1}B\]
\[(A^{-1}A)X = A^{-1}B\]
\[X = A^{-1}B\]
kyun ke \(A^{-1}A = I\) aur \(IX = X\). Yeh bilkul \(ax = b\) ko \(x = \frac{b}{a}\) se hal karne jaisa hai; farq sirf yeh hai ke matrices mein divide nahi karte, inverse se multiply karte hain.
\(A^{-1}\) hamesha \(B\) ke BAYEN taraf aata hai. Matrix multiplication commutative nahi, aur yahan \(BA^{-1}\) to bana bhi nahi sakte (\(3 \times 1\) ko \(3 \times 3\) se zarb mumkin nahi).
\(A^{-1}\) do tareeqon se nikal sakte hain: \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\) (Section 4.5) ya row operations (Section 4.7). Kitab yahan adjoint wala tareeqa leti hai.
Ab kitab ki Example 12 qadam ba qadam karte hain. Cofactors wala hissa lamba hai, is liye har cofactor alag line mein likha hai taa ke koi sign na chhoote.

blocks.title: Example 12
blocks.problem:
Use matrix inversion method to solve the system
\[x_1 - 2x_2 + x_3 = -4\]
\[2x_1 - 3x_2 + 2x_3 = -6\]
\[2x_1 + 2x_2 + x_3 = 5\]
steps:
Given: \(x_1, x_2, x_3\) mein teen equations ka system.
To find: \(x_1, x_2, x_3\) ki values.
Method: sab se pehle system ko \(AX = B\) ki shakal mein likhte hain. Agar \(|A| \ne 0\) ho to \(X = A^{-1}B\). \(A^{-1}\) adjoint formula \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\) se nikalenge, jo Section 4.5 mein seekha tha. Plan: determinant, cofactors, adjoint, inverse, aur aakhir mein zarb.

Step 1: Matrix form
\[\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 2 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 & 1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x_1 \\ x_2 \\ x_3\end{bmatrix}\]
\[= \begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -6 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}\]
or \(AX = B\) ...(i), where
\[A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 2 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 & 1\end{bmatrix}\]
\[X = \begin{bmatrix}x_1 \\ x_2 \\ x_3\end{bmatrix},\ B = \begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -6 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: har equation ke coefficients \(A\) ki ek row banate hain, aur constants \(B\) ka column. Variables ki tarteeb har equation mein same rakhni zaroori hai.

Step 2: \(|A|\) nikalein
\(R_2 + (-2)R_1 \to R_2'\):
\[|A| = \begin{vmatrix}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 2 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 & 1\end{vmatrix}\]
\[= \begin{vmatrix}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 2 & 1\end{vmatrix}\]
\(R_2\) ke saath expand karein:
\[= (-1)^{2+2}\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1\end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (1 - 2) = -1\]
Kyun: yeh row operation determinant ki value nahi badalta, aur \(R_2 = (0, 1, 0)\) bana deta hai, is liye expansion mein sirf ek term bachta hai. Kaam aadha reh gaya! \(|A| \ne 0\), is liye \(A^{-1}\) mojood hai aur (i) ko \(X = A^{-1}B\) ...(ii) likh sakte hain.

Step 3: Pehli row ke cofactors
\[A_{11} = +\begin{vmatrix}-3 & 2 \\ 2 & 1\end{vmatrix} = -3 - 4 = -7\]
\[A_{12} = -\begin{vmatrix}2 & 2 \\ 2 & 1\end{vmatrix} = -(2 - 4) = 2\]
\[A_{13} = +\begin{vmatrix}2 & -3 \\ 2 & 2\end{vmatrix} = 4 + 6 = 10\]
Kyun: \(A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}\); minor \(M_{ij}\) woh determinant hai jo row \(i\) aur column \(j\) kaat dene ke baad bachta hai. Signs ka pattern \(+, -, +\) hai.

Step 4: Doosri aur teesri row ke cofactors
\[A_{21} = -\begin{vmatrix}-2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1\end{vmatrix} = -(-2 - 2) = 4\]
\[A_{22} = +\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1\end{vmatrix} = 1 - 2 = -1\]
\[A_{23} = -\begin{vmatrix}1 & -2 \\ 2 & 2\end{vmatrix} = -(2 + 4) = -6\]
\[A_{31} = +\begin{vmatrix}-2 & 1 \\ -3 & 2\end{vmatrix} = -4 + 3 = -1\]
\[A_{32} = -\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{vmatrix} = -(2 - 2) = 0\]
\[A_{33} = +\begin{vmatrix}1 & -2 \\ 2 & -3\end{vmatrix} = -3 + 4 = 1\]
Kyun: row 2 ke signs \(-, +, -\) aur row 3 ke \(+, -, +\) hain (chessboard jaisa pattern). Is tarah
\[[A_{ij}]_{3\times 3} = \begin{bmatrix}-7 & 2 & 10 \\ 4 & -1 & -6 \\ -1 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\]

Step 5: Adjoint aur inverse
\[\operatorname{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix}-7 & 4 & -1 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 10 & -6 & 1\end{bmatrix}\]
\[A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A = \frac{1}{-1}\operatorname{adj} A\]
\[= \begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ -10 & 6 & -1\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(\operatorname{adj} A\) cofactor matrix ka transpose hai (rows columns ban jati hain). \(|A| = -1\) se divide karne par har entry ka sign badal jata hai.

Step 6: \(A^{-1}B\) zarb karein
\[X = \begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ -10 & 6 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -6 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}\]
\[= \begin{bmatrix}-28 + 24 + 5 \\ 8 - 6 + 0 \\ 40 - 36 - 5\end{bmatrix}\]
\[= \begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: har entry \(A^{-1}\) ki ek row aur \(B\) ke column ka zarb hai: misal \(7(-4) + (-4)(-6) + 1(5) = -28 + 24 + 5 = 1\).

Tasdeeq: \(x_1 = 1, x_2 = 2, x_3 = -1\) asal equations mein rakhein:
\[1 - 4 - 1 = -4\]
\[2 - 6 - 2 = -6\]
\[2 + 4 - 1 = 5\]
Teeno equations sahi. Jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar Example 12 mein \(|A|\) zero aata to kya hota? Sochiye.
Jawab: \(\frac{1}{|A|}\) bana hi nahi sakte, yani \(A^{-1}\) mojood nahi aur yeh tareeqa ruk jata. Us soorat mein system ke ya to beshumar solutions hote ya koi nahi, aur use echelon form (4.8.1) se hal karte.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi. \(2x + y = 5\), \(x - y = 1\).
\(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}\), \(|A| = -2 - 1 = -3\).
\(2 \times 2\) ke liye adjoint: diagonal ki jagah badlo, baaqi do ke sign badlo: \(\operatorname{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & -1 \\ -1 & 2\end{bmatrix}\).
\[X = \frac{1}{-3}\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -1 \\ -1 & 2\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}\]
\[= \frac{1}{-3}\begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}\]
Tasdeeq: \(2(2) + 1 = 5\), \(2 - 1 = 1\). Sahi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. System ko \(AX = B\) likho.
2. \(|A| \ne 0\) check karo; warna yeh tareeqa nahi chalega.
3. \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\); \(\operatorname{adj} A\) cofactors ke matrix ka transpose hai.
4. \(X = A^{-1}B\), \(A^{-1}\) bayen taraf.
5. Aakhir mein values asal equations mein rakh kar check karo.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\operatorname{adj} A\) likhte waqt cofactor matrix ka transpose bhool jana. Bachne ka tareeqa: pehle \([A_{ij}]\) poora likhein, phir rows ko columns banayein.
2. Cofactors ke sign ghalat: chessboard pattern \(+, -, +\) / \(-, +, -\) / \(+, -, +\) yaad rakhein.
3. \(X = BA^{-1}\) likhna. Sahi \(A^{-1}B\) hai.
4. \(|A|\) se divide karna bhool jana (yahan \(-1\), jo har sign badal deta hai).
